Fetch all current reservations that are Queued Reservations. These reservations are guests that have arrived at the hotel, but their room isn't ready, so they're sitting in a queue.

OperationId:getReservationsInQueue

Using this API you can assign reservations to the reservation queue if the guest's room is not ready for assignment or if there are no available rooms of the room type attached to the reservation. Housekeeping staff can use the Queue Rooms functionality to determine if there are guests waiting to check in to a particular room or type of room; if there are, the queue list can provide guidance in determining which rooms need attention first.

OperationId:addReservationToQueue
